ByteDance2TextToVideoNode.name: ByteDance2TextToVideoNode
ByteDance2TextToVideoNode.description: Generate video using Seedance 2.5 or 2.0 models based on a text prompt.

input_details.name: model
input_details.tooltip: Seedance 2.5 for the newest model, videos up to 30 seconds and mp4/mov output; Seedance 2.0 for maximum quality and 4k; Fast for speed optimization; Mini for the fastest, lowest-cost generation.
input_details.hint: Dynamic combo: pick one `options` value for `model`, then send each conditional sub-field below using its full dotted name (prefixed with `model.`, e.g. `model.<sub_field>`). Auto-grow list slots nest one level deeper (e.g. `model.<list>.<slot_1>`). Sending these fields flat (without the prefix) fails with required_input_missing.

input_details.name: model.prompt
input_details.tooltip: Text prompt for video generation. Put spoken lines in double quotes to steer the generated dialogue.

input_details.name: model.resolution
input_details.tooltip: Resolution of the output video.

input_details.name: model.ratio
input_details.tooltip: Aspect ratio of the output video.

input_details.name: model.duration
input_details.tooltip: Duration of the output video in seconds (4-30).

input_details.name: model.generate_audio
input_details.tooltip: Enable audio generation for the output video.

input_details.name: model.output_format
input_details.tooltip: Container format of the output video.

input_details.name: seed
input_details.tooltip: Seed controls whether the node should re-run; results are non-deterministic regardless of seed.

input_details.name: watermark
input_details.tooltip: Whether to add a watermark to the video.

ByteDance2ReferenceNodeV2.name: ByteDance2ReferenceNodeV2
ByteDance2ReferenceNodeV2.description: Generate, edit, or extend video using Seedance 2.5 or 2.0 with reference images, videos, and audio. Supports multimodal reference, video editing, and video extension.

input_details.name: model
input_details.tooltip: Seedance 2.5 for the newest model, videos up to 30 seconds and mp4/mov output; Seedance 2.0 for maximum quality and 4k; Fast for speed optimization; Mini for the fastest, lowest-cost generation.
input_details.hint: Dynamic combo: pick one `options` value for `model`, then send each conditional sub-field below using its full dotted name (prefixed with `model.`, e.g. `model.<sub_field>`). Auto-grow list slots nest one level deeper (e.g. `model.<list>.<slot_1>`). Sending these fields flat (without the prefix) fails with required_input_missing.

input_details.name: model.prompt
input_details.tooltip: Text prompt for video generation. Put spoken lines in double quotes to steer the generated dialogue.

input_details.name: model.resolution
input_details.tooltip: Resolution of the output video.

input_details.name: model.ratio
input_details.tooltip: Aspect ratio of the output video.

input_details.name: model.duration
input_details.tooltip: Duration of the output video in seconds (4-30).

input_details.name: model.generate_audio
input_details.tooltip: Enable audio generation for the output video.

input_details.name: model.task_type
input_details.tooltip: What to do with the reference media. Every value except auto is validated when the task is submitted, so mismatched settings fail before generation starts. auto: the model infers the task from the prompt and inputs, and settings that conflict with its reading fail only after generation has started. reference: generate a new video guided by the reference images, videos, and audio. edit: change a connected reference video (add, remove, replace); the output keeps the source clip's own length and aspect ratio, and the duration and ratio widgets are ignored. extend: continue a connected reference video forward or backward; the prompt should say 'extend forward', 'extend backward', or 'continue', the aspect ratio follows the source clip, and the output contains only the newly generated segment of the duration you set, not the source clip.

input_details.name: model.output_format
input_details.tooltip: Container format of the output video.

input_details.name: model.auto_downscale
input_details.tooltip: Automatically downscale reference videos that exceed the model's pixel budget for the selected resolution. Aspect ratio is preserved; videos already within limits are untouched.

input_details.name: model.auto_upscale
input_details.tooltip: Automatically upscale reference videos that are below the model's minimum pixel count for the selected resolution. Aspect ratio is preserved; videos already meeting the minimum are untouched. Note: upscaling a low-resolution source does not add real detail and may produce lower-quality generations.

input_details.name: seed
input_details.tooltip: Seed controls whether the node should re-run; results are non-deterministic regardless of seed.

input_details.name: watermark
input_details.tooltip: Whether to add a watermark to the video.
